title: Synthesis, Structural Investigations, DNA/BSA Interactions, Molecular Docking Studies, and Anticancer Activity of a New 1,4-Disubstituted 1,2,3-Triazole Derivative.
authors: Gokturk, Tolga; Sakalli Cetin, Esin; Hokelek, Tuncer; Pekel, Hanife; Sensoy, Ozge; Aksu, Ebru Nur; Gup, Ramazan
one_liner_zh: 该文报道一种三唑衍生物的小分子合成、晶体结构及其与DNA/BSA的结合和抗癌活性，虽含DNA互作与分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸而非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: We report herein a new 1,2,3-triazole derivative, namely, 4-((1-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)-1H-1,2,3-triazol-4-yl)methoxy)-2-hydroxybenzaldehyde, which was synthesized by copper(I)-catalyzed azide-alkyne cycloaddition (CuAAC). The structure of the compound was analyzed using Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), (1)H NMR, (13)C NMR, UV-vis, and elemental analyses. Moreover, X-ray crystallography studies demonstrated that the compound adapted a monoclinic crystal system with the P2(1)/c space group. The dominant interactions formed in the crystal packing were found to be hydrogen bonding and van der Waals interactions according to Hirshfeld surface (HS) analysis. The volume of the crystal voids and the percentage of free spaces in the unit cell were calculated as 152.10 A(3) and 9.80%, respectively. The evaluation of energy frameworks showed that stabilization of the compound was dominated by dispersion energy contributions. Both in vitro and in silico investigations on the DNA/bovine serum albumin (BSA) binding activity of the compound showed that the CT-DNA binding activity of the compound was mediated via intercalation and BSA binding activity was mediated via both polar and hydrophobic interactions. The anticancer activity of the compound was also tested by the 3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyltetrazolium bromide (MTT) assay using human cell lines including MDA-MB-231, LNCaP, Caco-2, and HEK-293. The compound exhibited more cytotoxic activity than cisplatin and etoposide on Caco-2 cancer cell lines with an IC(50) value of 16.63 +/- 0.27 muM after 48 h. Annexin V suggests the induction of cell death by apoptosis. Compound 3 significantly increased the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP) levels in Caco-2 cells, and the reactive oxygen species (ROS) assay proved that compound 3 could induce apoptosis by ROS generation.
abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种新的1,2,3-三唑衍生物，即4-((1-(3,4-二氯苯基)-1H-1,2,3-三唑-4-基)甲氧基)-2-羟基苯甲醛，其通过铜(I)催化的叠氮-炔环加成 (CuAAC) 反应合成。利用傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR)、(1)H NMR、(13)C NMR、紫外-可见光谱和元素分析对该化合物的结构进行了表征。此外，X射线晶体学研究显示，该化合物属于单斜晶系，空间群为P2(1)/c。根据Hirshfeld表面 (HS) 分析，晶体堆积中形成的主要相互作用为氢键和范德华力。晶胞中晶体空隙体积和自由空间百分比分别计算为152.10 A(3) 和9.80%。能量框架评估表明，该化合物的稳定性主要由色散能贡献主导。对该化合物的DNA/牛血清白蛋白 (BSA) 结合活性的体外和计算机模拟研究均显示，其CT-DNA结合活性通过嵌入机制介导，而BSA结合活性则通过极性和疏水相互作用共同介导。该化合物的抗癌活性也通过3-(4,5-二甲基噻唑-2-基)-2,5-二苯基四唑溴化物 (MTT) 法，使用包括MDA-MB-231、LNCaP、Caco-2和HEK-293在内的人类细胞系进行了测试。在Caco-2癌细胞系中，该化合物表现出比顺铂和依托泊苷更强的细胞毒性活性，48小时后的IC(50)值为16.63 ± 0.27 μM。Annexin V实验表明其诱导细胞凋亡。化合物3显著增加了Caco-2细胞中线粒体膜电位 (MMP) 水平的丧失，且活性氧 (ROS) 测定证明化合物3可通过ROS生成诱导凋亡。
